signal.label: SWANDEF
signal.legal_name: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited
signal.rationale: The Svitzer contract is firm (a signed contract to build four tugs), and it opens a new product and a new customer, so it is not routine. The press release gives no value, so size is estimated from quantity: 4 tugs x an assumed INR 50 crore (a low floor) = INR 200 crore, or 70.9% of TTM revenue of INR 282 crore. The company is loss-making (TTM PAT INR -226 crore), but no default, going-concern doubt or insolvency is in the packet and the order is itself the path to absorb fixed costs, so no disqualifier is applied; confidence is LOW because the value is estimated.

events.quote: KEY EVENTS IN H1FY27 BUILDING SHIPBUILDING TALENT OTHER UPDATES Project SWAVALAMBAN 1st DNV MOU in India Wins Maritime Skilling & Workforce Partnership with one of the leading Development Initiative of the Year classification societies
APPROVED PROJECT COST CAPITAL ASSISTANCE LOWER COST OF BORROWING

CLEAN SLATE – A FRESH RESTART EARLY CIRP CLOSURE: PREPAID COC OBLIGATIONS SDHI has completed the resolution-plan, cleared out of CIRP thereby creating a stronger base for scale-up 01 RESOLUTION PLAN CLOSED 1 2 3 → → CIRP Prepayment Scale-up Secured orders and fully Resolution framework CoC obligations settled operational closed Outcome: A clean operating platform, with the all CoC settled.
A new management of SDHI Physical possession of Ship repair operations Received 1stExport Order Order book ~ ₹ 6,500 Cr

Partnership: SDHI has signed a strategic MoU with DNV, the first such partnership with an Indian shipyard to strengthen capabilities across seven key areas including design certification, repair projects, R&D, supplier ecosystem, next-generation maritime technologies, digital adoption and cybersecurity.
The shipyard also secured an order from the A.P. Moller – Maersk backed Svitzer, for four TRAnsverse 3200 harbour tugs, with deliveries scheduled from early 2028.

Business Highlights Newbuilds: SDHI secured an order from Energy ONE Limited for four 92,500 DWT ammonia dual-fuel bulk carriers, the first of its kind for an Indian shipyard, with deliveries expected from FY30.

Further, in the month of March 2026, Transferee Company has repaid all the existing secured lenders and has obtained secured loan from one new lender [i.e. National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and CP(CAA)/ 28(AHM)2026 in CA(CAA)/ 1 7(AHM)2026 Triumph Offshore Private Limited & Anr.

SDHI Wins Order from Svitzer to Build four TRAnsverse 3200 Tugs Mumbai, August 06, 2026: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited (SDHI), India’s largest shipbuilding and heavy engineering company, has secured a contract from Denmark-based towage operator Svitzer A/S to construct four advanced TRAnsverse 3200 tugs.
